channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Attributes & Skills Panel->Cyberpunk: Character Vitals HUD
channelList.description: When the player increases Body or Reflexes via the upgrade controls, emit the new max-health/max-stamina values so the Vitals HUD raises its Health and Stamina bar maximums.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Attributes & Skills Panel->Cyberpunk: Quickhack Deck
channelList.description: When Intelligence is increased, emit the new RAM capacity and quickhack-effectiveness multiplier so the Quickhack Deck raises its total RAM units and updates per-hack damage/duration displays.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Cyberware Slot Grid->Cyberpunk: Character Vitals HUD
channelList.description: When armor- or health-granting cyberware is equipped/unequipped, emit the aggregate armor rating and bonus max-health so the Vitals HUD updates its Armor bar and Health bar maximum.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Cyberware Slot Grid->Cyberpunk: Quickhack Deck
channelList.description: When a cyberdeck is installed or swapped in the frontal-cortex slot, emit its RAM capacity and equippable quickhack slot count so the Quickhack Deck reconfigures its RAM pool and available program slots.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Mission Journal->Cyberpunk: Night City Map
channelList.description: When the player toggles 'Track' on a quest, emit the quest id, objective location, and marker type so the map pins the active waypoint, draws the route, and centers on it.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Night City Map->Cyberpunk: Mission Journal
channelList.description: When the player clicks a quest marker on the map, emit that quest's id so the journal highlights and selects the matching entry.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Inventory & Resources Ledger->Cyberpunk: Weapon Loadout Rack
channelList.description: When the player selects Equip on a weapon or throwable, emit the item and chosen slot so the loadout rack fills that slot; the previously equipped item is returned to this ledger.

channelList.id: Cyberpunk: Inventory & Resources Ledger->Cyberpunk: Cyberware Slot Grid
channelList.description: When the player selects Install on a cyberware item, emit the item and its target slot type so the cyberware grid places it into the matching body slot.
